ideas.name: Magnetic Pane secondary glazing kit
ideas.concept: Pre-cut clear PET/acrylic panes with magnetic-tape frame in the 6-8 most common Nordic window sizes; removable, no drilling, sold with size chart.
ideas.target_customer: Swedish/Danish renters and owners of older double-glazed windows, ages 28-55
ideas.problem_solved: Cold, draughty, condensing windows in winter without permanent works or rental-deposit risk.
ideas.trend_evidence: Forum threads show renters improvising with film, velcroed polycarbonate and magnetic panels; film is described as sagging after a year or as near-useless. No Reddit thread verified directly; demand signal is indirect.
ideas.defensibility_angle: Window-industry know-how: measured sizing system, U-value/daylight-transmission test data and a size configurator that film kits lack.
ideas.est_landed_cost_eur: 8-12 per window set at MOQ 300 (panes cut to size, no tooling)

ideas.name: Trickle-vent refresh kit
ideas.concept: Brush plus replaceable die-cut dust filter inserts and clip-in baffles for common window trickle vents; sold as annual refill pack.
ideas.target_customer: Nordic/UK-style homeowners with condensation and blocked or painted-shut window vents
ideas.problem_solved: Vents are clogged or blocked, so rooms get condensation and mould; people don't know how to maintain them.
ideas.trend_evidence: Forum/advice sources note vents are often painted shut, clogged with dust or blocked, and that many people close them in winter. Swedish Byggahus threads show recurring condensation/ventilation problems. Not verified as rising trend.
ideas.defensibility_angle: Fit-to-profile compatibility library for major window brands (building-industry edge) plus consumable filter refill; die-cut filter tooling is cheap.

ideas.name: Nordic Wood Care Bar
ideas.concept: Food-safe rapeseed-oil and beeswax/carnauba conditioning bar in a tin for cutting boards, wooden spoons and cast iron, with refill bars.
ideas.target_customer: Design-conscious home cooks with wooden boards and cast iron, SE/DK
ideas.problem_solved: Confusing, conflicting oil advice (flaxseed flakes, olive oil goes rancid); people want one simple food-safe product.
ideas.trend_evidence: r/castiron and woodworking forums show recurring debate about which oil/wax to use; flaxseed warnings and niche waxes like BuzzyWaxx recommended. Demand is steady rather than verified-rising.
ideas.defensibility_angle: Own formulation and Scandinavian brand/packaging; refill-and-tin ecosystem drives repeat purchase. Cosmetics/food-contact compliance is simple but needs a CPNP-free route (not a cosmetic).

ideas.name: Hard-Water Glass Rescue pack
ideas.concept: Citric-acid based dishwasher descaler sachets plus an etching-vs-limescale vinegar test card, sold as a 3-month set for hard-water regions.
ideas.target_customer: Households in hard-water areas (e.g. parts of Denmark/Skane) with cloudy glassware
ideas.problem_solved: Cloudy glasses: users cannot tell limescale from permanent etching, and use trial-and-error products.
ideas.trend_evidence: Manufacturer and advice pages repeatedly address cloudy glasses and the vinegar etching test; no Reddit thread verified. Category is crowded by Finish, Bosch and Hotpoint.
ideas.defensibility_angle: Weak: educational diagnostic card plus regional water-hardness map by postcode is the only copyable-resistant element; CLP/REACH labelling needed.

ideas.name: Spare-blade peeler
ideas.concept: Stamped-steel peeler with a stocked, subscription-able replacement-blade pack and turned-wood or recycled handle, positioned as buy-once-forever.
ideas.problem_solved: Peelers dull, advertised replacement blades are perpetually out of stock, parts for old appliances get pricier.
ideas.trend_evidence: A BIFL-roundup source reports a peeler with replaceable blades whose replacements are perpetually out of stock; a stand-mixer owner cites rising parts prices. Single anecdotes only.
ideas.defensibility_angle: Spare-parts-guaranteed promise and blade subscription; design is copyable, so brand and supply guarantee carry the moat. Retail price barely clears EUR 15 threshold.
